blocks.markdown: All sensitive personal information maintained by the government, its agencies and instrumentalities must be secured, as far as practicable, with the most appropriate ICT-industry standard as recommended by the Commission. The head of each agency or instrumentality is responsible for compliance; the Commission monitors compliance and may recommend action to meet minimum standards.

On-site and online access: no government employee may access SPI on government property or through online facilities without security clearance from the head of the source agency, except as Commission guidelines allow. Off-site access: SPI may not be transported or accessed off government property without a request submitted to and approved by the agency head — decided within two business days, with inaction deemed disapproval; approved access is capped at 1,000 records at a time and must use the most secure encryption standard recognized by the Commission.

blocks.markdown: Where a government contract may involve accessing or requiring SPI from 1,000 or more individuals, the agency must require the contractor and its employees to register their processing system with the Commission and to comply with the Act — including Section 23 — in the same manner as agencies and government employees.
